views.name: player_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  dob,
  batting_hand,
  bowling_skill,
  country_name
FROM player
views.description: Normalized player dimension: one row per player, canonicalizing obvious attributes. Use when you need player descriptive attributes for joins, labeling, or aggregations. | Use for: Lookups for player name/attributes by player_id; Filtering players by country, batting_hand, or bowling_skill; Joining player attributes onto event facts (balls, wickets, matches)
validated_on: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?

views.name: team_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  team_id,
  name
FROM team
views.description: Normalized team dimension: one row per team. Use for team labels and joins to match or event tables. | Use for: Retrieve team names by team_id; Join team names into match-level or event-level reports

views.name: match_dim
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  team_1,
  team_2,
  match_date,
  season_id,
  venue,
  toss_winner,
  toss_decision,
  win_type,
  win_margin,
  outcome_type,
  match_winner,
  man_of_the_match
FROM "match"
views.description: Match-level dimension: one row per match with key descriptive attributes. Useful as the base match relation for season/venue/toss/winner analyses. | Use for: Season-level counts, venue-based summaries, filtering matches by outcome or toss decision; Joining matches to teams or player participation

views.name: player_match_participation
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  player_id,
  role,
  team_id
FROM player_match
views.description: One row per player-match participation with the player's role and team in that match. Use when joining players to matches or computing per-player per-match metrics. | Use for: Which players played in a given match or season; Aggregate player appearances by season or team; Filter players by role (e.g., Captain)
validated_on: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.

views.name: ball_event
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  team_batting,
  team_bowling,
  striker_batting_position,
  striker,
  non_striker,
  bowler
FROM ball_by_ball
views.description: Canonical ball-level event row: one row per ball identified by match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id, with batting/bowling players and teams. Use as the primary fact table for ball-level analyses and to join other ball-level event tables. | Use for: Ball-level aggregations: runs per over, balls faced by a batsman, bowler analysis; Joining batsman_scored, wicket_taken, extra_runs to assemble full ball outcomes

views.name: batsman_run_event
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  runs_scored
FROM batsman_scored
views.description: Batsman runs recorded at ball-level: one row per (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) with runs_scored. Use to compute batsman-level totals or to join to ball_event for full-event context. | Use for: Compute runs per batsman per match/season when joined to player/player_match; Ball-level run distributions (dot balls vs scoring events)

views.name: wicket_event
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  player_out,
  kind_out
FROM wicket_taken
views.description: Wicket events at ball-level: one row per (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) with player_out and kind_out. Use to count dismissals, join to players or balls, and analyze dismissal types. | Use for: Count wickets by bowler or fielder when joined appropriately; Analyze dismissal types over time or by venue

views.name: extra_event
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  innings_no,
  over_id,
  ball_id,
  extra_type,
  extra_runs
FROM extra_runs
views.description: Extra runs at ball-level: one row per (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id) with extra_type and extra_runs. Use to include extras when computing total runs or distinguishing batsman runs from extras. | Use for: Compute total extras by type for innings/match; Include extras when deriving total runs per innings or per over

views.name: ball_event_full
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.team_batting,
  b.team_bowling,
  b.striker_batting_position,
  b.striker,
  b.non_striker,
  b.bowler,
  bs.runs_scored,
  er.extra_type,
  er.extra_runs,
  w.player_out,
  w.kind_out
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON er.match_id = b.match_id AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no AND er.over_id = b.over_id AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
views.description: Denormalized ball-level event: one row per ball combining ball_by_ball, batsman_scored, extra_runs, and wicket_taken where present. Use for analyses that need complete event context without repeatedly joining the event tables. | Use for: Compute total runs per over/inning including extras; Per-ball summaries for visualization or event sequence reconstruction; Bowler/batsman metrics at ball-level with dismissal and extra context

views.name: player_match_batting_summary
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.striker AS player_id,
  COUNT(1) AS balls_faced,
  SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS runs_scored
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.striker
views.description: Aggregated batting summary per player per match: total runs_scored and balls_faced (count of ball events where player was striker). Use to compute per-match batting performance for players. | Use for: Per-match batting aggregates for leaderboards; Compute strike rates when combined with runs and balls

views.name: bowler_match_wickets
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.bowler,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.bowler
views.description: Aggregated wicket counts per bowler per match: number of wickets taken. Use for match- or season-level bowler performance when joined to match or player. | Use for: Count wickets per bowler per match or aggregate to season; Identify top wicket-takers in a match or season

views.name: innings_total_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  be.match_id,
  be.innings_no,
  SUM(COALESCE(be.runs_scored,0) + COALESCE(be.extra_runs,0)) AS total_runs,
  SUM(COALESCE(be.runs_scored,0)) AS batsman_runs,
  SUM(COALESCE(be.extra_runs,0)) AS extras
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    b.over_id,
    b.ball_id,
    bs.runs_scored,
    er.extra_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON er.match_id = b.match_id AND er.innings_no = b.innings_no AND er.over_id = b.over_id AND er.ball_id = b.ball_id
) be
GROUP BY
  be.match_id,
  be.innings_no
views.description: Total runs per innings including batsman runs and extras. Use to compute innings totals and to join with match to get match-level scoring outcomes. | Use for: Compute innings totals for scorecards; Compare batsman contribution vs extras by innings or match

views.name: player_career_aggregates
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(pr.runs_scored,0)) AS career_runs,
  SUM(COALESCE(bw.wickets,0)) AS career_wickets
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    b.striker AS player_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0)) AS runs_scored
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.striker
) pr ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    b.bowler AS player_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.player_out IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.bowler
) bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id
views.description: Career aggregates per player across all matches: total runs (from batsman_scored when player was striker) and total wickets (when player appeared as bowler and wicket recorded). Use for career leaderboards and per-player summaries. | Use for: Career leaderboards for runs and wickets; Player summary cards combining batting and bowling aggregates

views.name: match_team_roles
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.match_id,
  m.team_1 AS team_id,
  1 AS is_team_1,
  0 AS is_team_2,
  CASE WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team_1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_toss_winner,
  CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match_winner
FROM "match" m
UNION ALL
SELECT
  m.match_id,
  m.team_2 AS team_id,
  0 AS is_team_1,
  1 AS is_team_2,
  CASE WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_toss_winner,
  CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_match_winner
FROM "match" m
views.description: One row per match-team role: emits one row for each referenced team in a match (team_1, team_2, toss_winner, match_winner) with role flags. Use to analyze team participation per match and to count wins/tosses by team. | Use for: Count wins/tosses by team, filter matches by team participation, join to team_dim for team names

views.name: clean_balls
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.bowler,
  br.runs_scored AS batsman_runs,
  e.extra_runs AS extra_runs
FROM
  ball_event b
LEFT JOIN
  batsman_run_event br
  ON b.match_id = br.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = br.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = br.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = br.ball_id
LEFT JOIN
  extra_event e
  ON b.match_id = e.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = e.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id
WHERE
  b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  AND br.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
  AND e.extra_runs IS NOT NULL
views.description: Normalized/cleaned ball-level rows combining ball_by_ball with numeric runs fields and canonical bowler; filter out rows with NULLs in bowler, batsman runs, or extra runs so downstream aggregates ignore incomplete data.

views.name: over_run_totals_per_innings
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  COALESCE(b.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0) AS runs_conceded_in_over
FROM batsman_scored b
LEFT JOIN extra_runs e
  ON b.match_id = e.match_id
  AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  AND b.over_id = e.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id
views.description: Total runs conceded in each over within an innings (sum of batsman runs + extra runs) computed per match, innings, and over.

views.name: match_max_over_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  over_runs.match_id AS match_id,
  MAX(over_runs.runs_conceded_in_over) AS max_runs_in_match
FROM (
  SELECT
    b.match_id,
    b.innings_no,
    b.over_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored,0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs,0)),0) AS runs_conceded_in_over
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
    ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
    AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
    AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs e
    ON e.match_id = b.match_id
    AND e.innings_no = b.innings_no
    AND e.over_id = b.over_id
    AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
) AS over_runs
GROUP BY over_runs.match_id
views.description: For each match, the maximum runs conceded by any single over within that match — considering innings separately (i.e., treat match_id + innings_no + over_id as distinct overs), then taking the maximum per match across those overs.

views.name: over_bowler_assignment
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler_player_id,
  SUM(COALESCE(b.runs_scored,0) + COALESCE(b.extra_runs,0)) AS runs_conceded_in_over
FROM
  ball_event_full b
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  b.innings_no,
  b.over_id,
  b.bowler
HAVING
  -- only keep bowlers who bowled the maximum number of legal/total balls in that over (majority/tie)
  -- compute number of balls by this bowler in the over and compare to max per over
  (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
     FROM ball_event_full b2
     WHERE b2.match_id = b.match_id
       AND b2.innings_no = b.innings_no
       AND b2.over_id = b.over_id
     GROUP BY b2.bowler
  )) = (
     SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM ball_event_full b3
     WHERE b3.match_id = b.match_id
       AND b3.innings_no = b.innings_no
       AND b3.over_id = b.over_id
       AND b3.bowler = b.bowler
  )
AND
  -- ensure this over is a top-scoring over in its match (equals match max)
  (SELECT SUM(COALESCE(b4.runs_scored,0)+COALESCE(b4.extra_runs,0))
   FROM ball_event_full b4
   WHERE b4.match_id = b.match_id
     AND b4.innings_no = b.innings_no
     AND b4.over_id = b.over_id
  ) = (
   SELECT match_max_over_runs.max_runs_in_match
   FROM match_max_over_runs
   WHERE match_max_over_runs.match_id = b.match_id
  )
views.description: For each over (match_id + innings_no + over_id) that is a top-scoring over in its match, identify the bowler(s) who bowled the majority of balls in that over (if tie, include all tied bowlers). Produce one row per bowler-over pair with the associated runs conceded in that over.

views.name: delivery_with_bowler_and_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  b.over_id,
  b.ball_id,
  b.bowler AS bowler,
  bs.runs_scored AS batsman_runs,
  e.extra_runs AS extra_runs
FROM ball_by_ball b
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
  ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
  AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
  AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_runs e
  ON e.match_id = b.match_id
  AND e.over_id = b.over_id
  AND e.ball_id = b.ball_id
WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per delivery (ball) that attributes the delivery to a non-null bowler and attaches the batsman runs and extra runs for that delivery. Joins ball_by_ball to batsman_scored and extra_runs by (match_id, over_id, ball_id) and keeps deliveries where bowler is present.

views.name: wicket_events_with_bowler
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  w.match_id,
  w.over_id,
  w.ball_id,
  b.bowler,
  w.player_out
FROM
  wicket_taken AS w
JOIN
  ball_by_ball AS b
  ON b.match_id = w.match_id
  AND b.over_id = w.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
WHERE
  b.bowler IS NOT NULL
views.description: One row per wicket event that links wicket_taken to the corresponding delivery and attributes the wicket to the bowler who delivered that ball by joining on (match_id, over_id, ball_id). Exclude events where the delivery's bowler is null.

views.name: bowler_aggregate_stats
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.bowler AS bowler,
  SUM(IFNULL(br.runs_scored, 0) + IFNULL(e.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs_conceded,
  COUNT(w.player_out) AS total_wickets_taken
FROM ball_event b
LEFT JOIN batsman_run_event br
  ON b.match_id = br.match_id AND b.innings_no = br.innings_no AND b.over_id = br.over_id AND b.ball_id = br.ball_id
LEFT JOIN extra_event e
  ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id
LEFT JOIN wicket_event w
  ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
GROUP BY b.bowler
views.description: One row per bowler computing total runs conceded (sum of batsman_runs + extra_runs across deliveries they bowled) and total wickets taken (count of wicket events attributed to them). Aggregates over all matches/innings; does not apply final filters like requiring at least one wicket.

views.name: match_player_total_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.match_id,
  be.striker AS player_id,
  SUM(b.runs_scored) AS total_runs
FROM
  batsman_scored b
JOIN
  ball_by_ball be
  ON b.match_id = be.match_id
  AND b.over_id = be.over_id
  AND b.ball_id = be.ball_id
  AND b.innings_no = be.innings_no
GROUP BY
  b.match_id,
  be.striker
views.description: For each player in each match, compute the total runs they scored in that match (summing all runs by the player in that match).

views.name: players_with_match_high_scores
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  mpt.match_id,
  mpt.player_id,
  mpt.total_runs
FROM
  match_player_total_runs AS mpt
views.description: Subset of player-match totals for player performances where the player's total_runs in that match exceeds a threshold (threshold to be applied at query time).

views.name: match_results
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.match_id AS match_id,
  CASE
    WHEN m.outcome_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN lower(m.outcome_type) = 'result' AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN m.match_winner
    ELSE NULL
  END AS winner_team_id,
  CASE
    WHEN m.outcome_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN lower(m.outcome_type) = 'result' AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE
        WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_1 THEN m.team_2
        WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_2 THEN m.team_1
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ELSE NULL
  END AS loser_team_id
FROM match_dim m
views.description: Canonical match-level result rows indicating winner and loser team ids for each match. Normalize outcome fields so each match row includes match_id, winner_team_id and loser_team_id (nulls if tie/no-result).

views.name: player_match_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.player_id AS player_id,
  pm.match_id AS match_id,
  COALESCE(bm.total_runs, bb.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs
FROM
  player_match_participation pm
LEFT JOIN (
  -- aggregate runs from batsman_run_event (batsman_scored-like source)
  SELECT
    match_id,
    innings_no,
    /* batsman_run_event does not include player_id in provided listing,
       so join back to player_match_participation by matching striker from ball_event.
       However we prefer using provided aggregated view match_player_total_runs if available.
       Use it when present to avoid referencing non-existent columns. */
    NULL AS player_id_placeholder,
    match_id || '-' || innings_no AS join_key,
    SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM batsman_run_event
  GROUP BY match_id, innings_no
) bm ON 1=0
LEFT JOIN match_player_total_runs bb ON bb.match_id = pm.match_id AND bb.player_id = pm.player_id
views.description: Aggregated runs scored by each player in each match (one row per player-match) combining ball-level and batsman-scored sources as canonical total_runs_per_player_match.

views.name: match_losing_team_players_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pmp.player_id AS player_id,
  pmp.match_id AS match_id,
  pmp.team_id AS team_id,
  COALESCE(mpr.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
  mr.loser_team_id AS loser_team_id
FROM player_match_participation pmp
JOIN match_dim m ON pmp.match_id = m.match_id
LEFT JOIN player_match_runs mpr
  ON mpr.match_id = pmp.match_id
  AND mpr.player_id = pmp.player_id
LEFT JOIN match_results mr
  ON mr.match_id = pmp.match_id
WHERE mr.loser_team_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pmp.team_id = mr.loser_team_id
views.description: For each player-match, attach the match result and identify players who were playing for the losing team in that match (includes player_id, match_id, team_id, total_runs, loser_team_id).

views.name: season_matches
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  match_id,
  season_id
FROM
  "match"
views.description: All matches that belong to a particular season (one row per match). This identifies the set of match_ids for a season.

views.name: player_delivery_runs
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  bb.striker AS player_id,
  bb.match_id AS match_id,
  SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_in_match
FROM
  ball_by_ball AS bb
JOIN
  batsman_scored AS bs
  ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
  AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
  AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
  AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  AND bb.striker = bb.striker
GROUP BY
  bb.striker,
  bb.match_id
views.description: Total runs scored by each player on deliveries (as striker) per match. Aggregates batsman_scored.runs_scored joined to ball_by_ball to attribute each delivery to a striker and a match.

views.name: player_match_participation_28
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.player_id AS player_id,
  bm.match_id AS match_id,
  CASE WHEN bm.player_present = 1 OR pm.player_present = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS participated
FROM
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE striker IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT non_striker AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE non_striker IS NOT NULL

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT bowler AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
  ) AS bm
FULL OUTER JOIN
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
    FROM player_match
  ) AS pm
ON bm.player_id = pm.player_id AND bm.match_id = pm.match_id
JOIN
  (
    SELECT COALESCE(bm.player_id, pm.player_id) AS player_id,
           COALESCE(bm.match_id, pm.match_id) AS match_id,
           COALESCE(bm.player_present, 0) AS bm_player_present,
           COALESCE(pm.player_present, 0) AS pm_player_present
    FROM
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT striker AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
        FROM ball_by_ball
        WHERE striker IS NOT NULL

        UNION

        SELECT DISTINCT non_striker AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
        FROM ball_by_ball
        WHERE non_striker IS NOT NULL

        UNION

        SELECT DISTINCT bowler AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
        FROM ball_by_ball
        WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
      ) bm
    LEFT JOIN
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
        FROM player_match
      ) pm
    ON bm.player_id = pm.player_id AND bm.match_id = pm.match_id

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT pm.player_id AS player_id, pm.match_id AS match_id,
           COALESCE(bm.player_present, 0) AS bm_player_present,
           COALESCE(pm.player_present, 1) AS pm_player_present
    FROM
      (SELECT DISTINCT player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present FROM player_match) pm
    LEFT JOIN
      (
        SELECT DISTINCT striker AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
        FROM ball_by_ball
        WHERE striker IS NOT NULL

        UNION

        SELECT DISTINCT non_striker AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
        FROM ball_by_ball
        WHERE non_striker IS NOT NULL

        UNION

        SELECT DISTINCT bowler AS player_id, match_id, 1 AS player_present
        FROM ball_by_ball
        WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
      ) bm
    ON bm.player_id = pm.player_id AND bm.match_id = pm.match_id
  ) AS p
ON p.player_id = p.player_id
views.description: One row per player per match indicating whether the player participated. Uses ball_by_ball (player as striker) and player_match to capture participation; a match-player pair is present if either source indicates participation.
